title: opencode.json CONFIG-01 hermetic subset schema
description: VENDORED SUBSET schema — a validation AID for the hermetic structural gate (D-02), NOT the opencode runtime's own schema. The test asserts jsonschema.validate(harness/opencode.json, this) so opencode.json drift/typos are caught with no network (never fetch opencode.ai — 403 + non-hermetic, T-03-08). `additionalProperties: true` so unknown/future opencode keys never fail the gate; this schema only pins the CONFIG-01 keys this phase must carry.

model.description: Expensive implementer default tier (placeholder token, no real model ID).

small_model.description: Cheap explorer/summarization tier (placeholder token; key name A1-deferred to Phase 6).

instructions.description: Glob pointers to AGENTS.md rules — pointers only, not contracts/** payloads (P2).

formatter.description: name -> { command, extensions } formatter wiring (ruff for .py, dotnet format for .cs).

mcp.description: MCP server wiring, config-only (D-03). Empty object is valid.

permission.description: Coarse project-default permission block; the detailed 15-key matrix lives in harness/permission-matrix.json.

bash.description: Either a coarse decision or an insertion-ordered glob->decision object (last-wins, `*` first).
